name: Hexploration
description:
# Hexploration

Cover a hex map with opaque hexes that are revealed as the party explores. Draw a polygon over the area to hide, fill it with hexes, and every hex a player token moves through (and, optionally, the hexes around it) is uncovered. Hidden locations are announced in chat when they are discovered.

**Version 2.0.0 is a full rewrite that works in Jumpgate and in Legacy games.** It no longer needs PathMath, MatrixMath, Vector Math or HTML Builder. Existing v1 hex maps and the v1 `!hexploration_*` commands keep working.

## Getting started

1. Use a page with a **Hex (V)** or **Hex (H)** grid.
2. Draw one or more polygons over the area to hide and select them.
3. Type `!hexploration fill`, or open the **Hexploration - Command Deck** handout and click **Fill**.
4. Move a player token and watch the map open up.

Type `!hexploration` for the menu, or `!hexploration help` for every command. The **Hexploration - Help** handout is created in the Journal on startup.

## Features

* Works with Jumpgate (`pathv2`) and Legacy paths, on both hex grid orientations and any cell size.
* Hexes are drawn on the foreground layer when the game has one, otherwise on the token layer.
* Reveals along the whole path a token travels, covers every hex a large token occupies, and respects line of sight.
* Optional glimpse mode: nearby hexes turn see-through and clear when a token enters them.
* Named locations and hidden location tokens, announced (and optionally pinged) when discovered.
* Reveal or re-cover selected hexes, reveal or clear a page, undo the last fill, and per-page settings.
* Rescan rebuilds the hex list after a page is duplicated or a Legacy game is copied to Jumpgate.
* Grid calibration for maps whose hexes do not line up.
* Translated into 24 languages.

Original mod by Ada Lindberg. Version 2 is maintained by MidNiteShadow7.

useroptions.name: hexLayer
useroptions.description: Where new hexes are drawn. Auto uses the foreground layer when the game supports it, otherwise the token (objects) layer.

useroptions.name: revealBy
useroptions.description: Which tokens on the token layer reveal hexes when they move: players (controlled by a player), characters (represent any character, the v1 behaviour) or all tokens.

useroptions.name: language
useroptions.description: Language code for GM messages, menus and handouts. Run !hexploration set language to see all supported codes.
